name: Logic request

title: Request to add (logic name)

---

## Abstract

Describe the logic and summarize its potential use cases.

## Use cases

- Expand on each mentioned use case in a list.

## Theoretical implementation

How this would probably be implemented.

It would be best to include the bodies of the `__and__`, `__or__` and `__invert__`
methods, and also possibly `from_normalized` and `normalize`, beside the
selling points of the logic type.

Pseudocode is fine in this early stage.

## Links

Link to online sources related to this logic, such as research papers, books and
websites.
